description: A complete HTML webpage implementing a frontend interface for visualizing database contents, including UI components, styling, and client-side JavaScript for interactive data fetching and display.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases upon user request.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database entry to show tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data in tabular format into the container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects, nulls, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better viewing.
